decisive_items: bronchial wall thickening and numerous granular shadows
inflammatory cell infiltration and fibrosis around bronchioles
response.rationale: Combination of upper respiratory (sinusitis) and lower respiratory (bronchial wall thickening, granular shadows) involvement with biopsy showing lymphocytic infiltration and fibrosis is most consistent with Wegener's granulomatosis, despite lack of classic granulomas/vasculitis. Churg-Strauss is less likely without asthma/eosinophilia.

rejected.why: No bronchiectasis on imaging; sinusitis alone insufficient.
Prior TB but current imaging and biopsy not typical of active TB.
No exposure history; biopsy not typical of HP.
No asthma or eosinophilia; cold agglutinin not specific.
No organizing pneumonia pattern; sinusitis unexplained.
COPD does not explain sinusitis or biopsy findings.
